patterns.name: Controlled Intervention / A-B Falsification
patterns.claim: Test one intervention against a matched control before promoting a new assumption.
composition_laws: one intervention plus matched control identifies causal effect
transfer_predictions: A candidate with control-variable context should declare trigger and control rows before acceptance.

patterns.name: Incremental Replacement / Module Boundary Preservation
patterns.claim: Keep a working pipeline and replace one bounded module at a time with rollback.
composition_laws: preserved pipeline + one bounded replacement + rollback supports safe iteration
transfer_predictions: For high-risk system changes, structural context should prefer one-module replacement with rollback over whole-system rewrite.

patterns.name: Negative Feedback / Equilibrium Restoration
patterns.claim: An induced response opposes an external perturbation under a constraint or stability principle.
composition_laws: perturbation induces response; response opposes perturbation
disturbance creates compensating reaction that cancels change
transfer_predictions: If the mapping is valid, an answer should identify the perturbation, induced response, and preserved constraint.

patterns.name: Residual Correction / Identity-Preserving Update
patterns.claim: Preserve a verified baseline or identity path while learning only the local delta.
transfer_predictions: When a plan risks destructive overwrite, structural context should preserve the old path and apply only a local delta.

patterns.name: Signal vs Stochastic Nuisance Separation
patterns.claim: Bias estimation toward predictable structure while suppressing stochastic nuisance variation.
composition_laws: predictable structure is retained while uncorrelated nuisance is suppressed
transfer_predictions: A valid transfer should improve stable-state prediction or denoising while avoiding reconstruction of nuisance details.
